items.exampleEn: The hotel bed was fantastically comfortable.
items.exampleZh: 飯店的床舒服得不得了。

items.exampleEn: The kittens were irresistibly cute, so we took one home.
items.exampleZh: 那些小貓可愛得讓人無法抗拒，所以我們帶了一隻回家。
items.glossZh: 無法抗拒地；極吸引人地

items.exampleEn: The shop sells unfashionable clothes at very low prices.
items.exampleZh: 那家店用很低的價格賣退流行的衣服。

items.exampleEn: Life without electricity seems unimaginably hard today.
items.exampleZh: 在今天，沒有電的生活似乎困難得難以想像。

items.exampleEn: The balky horse stopped at the river and refused to cross.
items.exampleZh: 那匹不聽使喚的馬停在河邊，不肯過河。

items.exampleEn: This rubber toy bends flexibly in any direction.
items.exampleZh: 這個橡膠玩具可以往任何方向彎曲。

items.exampleEn: Sea water is not drinkable because it contains too much salt.
items.exampleZh: 海水不能喝，因為含鹽量太高。

items.exampleEn: The rules of this game are mutable; players can change them together.
items.exampleZh: 這個遊戲的規則是可變的，玩家可以一起修改。

items.sentenceEn: Our office lets us work flexibly from home on Fridays.
items.sentenceZh: 我們公司讓我們星期五可以彈性地在家工作。

items.audioEn: Those wide jeans were unfashionable ten years ago, but now everyone wants them.
items.audioZh: 那種寬版牛仔褲十年前退流行，但現在大家都想要。
items.questionZh: 寬版牛仔褲現在怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: The smell of fresh coffee pulled us irresistibly into the shop.
items.sentenceZh: 新鮮咖啡的香味讓我們忍不住走進店裡。

items.sentenceEn: This balky printer only works if you hit it twice.
items.sentenceZh: 這台不聽話的印表機要拍兩下才會動。

items.stemEn: Is this tap water ____, or should I buy a bottle?
items.stemZh: 這個水龍頭的水可以喝嗎？還是我該買一瓶？

items.stemEn: The concert was ____ good; I want to go again next year.
items.stemZh: 那場音樂會好得不得了，我明年還想再去。

items.passageEn: Last month, my friends and I went camping in the mountains. Our balky old car broke down twice on the way, so we arrived after dark. The campsite had a tap with drinkable water and a small shop. The weather up there was mutable: sunny in the morning, foggy at noon and windy at night. We planned flexibly and walked to a lower peak when the fog came in. At night, the sky was unimaginably clear, with thousands of stars.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我和朋友們去山上露營。我們那輛不聽話的老車在路上拋錨了兩次，所以天黑後才到。營地有一個可以生飲的水龍頭和一間小店。山上的天氣變化多端：早上晴朗、中午起霧、晚上颳風。起霧時，我們彈性調整計畫，改走到一座較矮的山頂。晚上的天空清澈得難以想像，滿天都是星星。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼天黑後才到營地？

items.promptZh: 從山頂往下看，那片森林大得難以想像。
referenceEn: From the top of the mountain, the forest looks unimaginably large.
Seen from the mountain top, the forest seems unimaginably big.
rubricZh: 要用 unimaginably 修飾形容詞（例如 unimaginably large、unimaginably big 等）
「看起來」可寫，例如 looks、seems、is 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 looks、looked 等）

items.promptZh: 現在很少人寫信了，寫信似乎已經過時。
referenceEn: Few people write letters now; writing letters seems unfashionable.
Writing letters seems unfashionable now, and few people do it anymore.
rubricZh: unfashionable 當形容詞，接在 seem、be 等動詞後（例如 seems unfashionable 等）
「很少人」可寫，例如 few people、not many people 等
